title: Trust · receipt signing
subtitle: This device can sign the answer receipts you download, with a key that never leaves the browser. Share its public key with whoever checks your receipts.

sign.label: Sign exported receipts
sign.hint: Each downloaded receipt names this device's key as its signer and carries its signature. Anyone can then check that the receipt is unchanged; with your public key they can also check that this device signed it.

key.title: Signing key of this device
key.rotate_confirm: Make a new signing key? Receipts are signed with the new key from now on; the old key never signs again, and its public key stays available for export.
key.delete_confirm: Delete the signing key of this device? Receipts it signed still verify with its public key, if you exported it. A new key is made with the next signed receipt.
key.none: No signing key yet. One is made when you first open an answer receipt with signing on, or now.
key.unavailable: This browser cannot make signing keys here (WebCrypto needs a secure connection). Receipts are downloaded without a signature.
key.not_persistent: This browser does not keep data for this site (for example in a private window): the key lasts only until the page is closed.

retired.title: Earlier keys
retired.body: Keys replaced by a new one no longer sign. Their public keys still check the receipts they signed.
retired.delete_confirm: Delete this earlier key? Its public key can then no longer be exported here.

check.title: Checking a signed receipt
check.body: Give the receipt, the original files and your public key to the person who checks. Only a public key they received from you shows who signed; the key inside a receipt only shows that it is unchanged.

result.rotated: New signing key made. Export its public key for whoever checks your receipts.
result.sign_page: Saved for this page only: this browser does not keep data for this site.

error.unavailable: This browser cannot make or use signing keys here.
error.storage: The key could not be stored on this device.

receipt.unsigned_off: Not signed: signing is turned off in Settings › Trust.
receipt.unsigned_unavailable: Not signed: this browser cannot make a signing key here.
receipt.signer: Signer named in the receipt: key {key} ({alg}).
receipt.signature_missing: The receipt names signer key {key} ({alg}), but its signature was removed.
receipt.trusted: Trusted: checked with the public key you chose.
receipt.not_trusted: Not trusted: no public key of the signer was chosen, and the key inside a receipt can be anyone's.
receipt.own_key: The key belongs to this device.
receipt.gate: Sentence gate ({mode} mode, as recorded): {released} released, {withheld} withheld.
receipt.second_opinions: Second opinions recorded for {n} {n:statement|statements}, {contradicted} contradicted (advisory, not recomputed).
receipt.relations: {n} {n:relation|relations} between statements recorded, {flagged} inverted or unsupported (not recomputed).
receipt.check_ocr: {label}: the file matches; its text was recognised by OCR and cannot be extracted again.
